additional_coverage_selection.network_behavior: No validation, revocation, scanner execution or runtime source download.
additional_coverage_selection.scope: Optional local detection with independently reviewed ASCII subsets; inherited native global policy remains additional policy.

a.byte_entropy: byte-shannon-f64-v1, ascending byte histogram, f64 probability/log2/accumulation, reject lt. Equality is accepted. No arbitrary-platform libm bit-equivalence claim.

byte_scope_corrections.asaas_and_buildkite_service: Negated token-alphabet delimiters are narrowed to explicitly enumerated ASCII bytes outside A-Za-z0-9_-. A consumed delimiter is exactly one byte. Non-ASCII and invalid delimiter bytes are outside this proposal.
byte_scope_corrections.capella: Each bounded any-byte gap is narrowed to ASCII 00..7f, preserving byte bounds within that selected scope. Non-ASCII and invalid context bytes are outside this proposal.
byte_scope_corrections.fal: The unescaped source dot in fal.ai is narrowed to ASCII 00..09 or 0b..7f, preserving its one-byte non-LF scope.
byte_scope_corrections.other_rows: Static syntax inspection found no other unescaped detector dots or negated character classes among the 48 assigned original patterns.
byte_scope_corrections.owning_source: Pinned Kingfisher crates/kingfisher-rules/src/rule.rs:1481-1486 builds regex::bytes with unicode(false). Rustleaks crates/rustleaks-core/src/regex/mod.rs:396-397 enables Unicode/UTF-8, and :2319/:2445 specify rune consumption for negated classes/dot.

a.flag_scope_difference: The inherited legacy global regex union leaks case folding into later alternatives. The local source copies preserve independent scopes but cannot undo inherited exclusions. This is reachable for dollar-prefixed Asaas values made entirely of letters/underscores, and potentially slash-leading Capella base64-like captures. Record it as inherited native policy, not a source-preservation claim.

native_allowlist.description: Independently scoped source global secret exclusions

a.native_inheritance: Keep the native base global policy unchanged. Add independently scoped copies of all source secret predicates and all 23 source path exclusions to every proposed optional rule. Do not copy online validation, analysis or revocation programs.
a.path_difference: No source path rejection is discarded. Local source exclusions include bun.lock and bun.lockb at root or below a slash. Native defaults additionally exclude office/PDF/binary extensions and .git. These additional inherited exclusions are not source-policy equivalence.
a.source_filter_shape: Every assigned generated filter AST is global matchesAny OR global containsAny OR entropy(secret) < threshold. The shared path prefilter has all 23 exclusions copied locally. No tokenizer, required component, extra rule-local path predicate or other detection filter is present.

associations.byte_regex: Every association node uses regex={dialect=bytes-v1,pattern=exact generated source pattern}. Inline flags, raw bytes, byte counts, captures and greedy/lazy enumeration are retained without Go syntax translation.
associations.reporting: Every qualifying helper occurrence appears in required_findings, in edge and occurrence order. Helpers are never standalone. Parent serialization omits supports, while explicit RequiredFinding serialization exposes them.
associations.scope: 26 reporting parents with 30 hidden helpers; every mandatory source context edge is retained.
associations.source_context: Same raw or individual decoded buffer. NL includes helper starts from parent full-match start minus N-1 to its exclusive full-match end plus N-1, inclusive; 0 is unlimited only within that buffer.
associations.source_depth: Depth-two tests prove native input isolation; they do not claim recursive-decoding parity with the no-options source API.
associations.source_global_policy_qualifier: Existing native global policy remains an additional unchanged layer. Each applicable source secret filter remains local, and all 23 source path exclusions remain on every selected node. Explicit zero-entropy rejection preserves otherwise unexpressed source scanner floors.

source_policy.native_global_policy: Unchanged pinned native base remains additional policy. Copy all 23 source path regexes into each selected rule as local exclusions; no source-path restriction is discarded. Independent regex scoping prevents flags leaking between source alternatives. Native base also excludes office/PDF/binary paths and .git.
source_policy.source_filter_arithmetic: Kingfisher counts UTF-8 bytes and accumulates f64 histogram Shannon entropy; every captured secret here is ASCII. Native byte-shannon-f64-v1 retains reject lt and threshold. No arbitrary Unicode-string or cross-platform log2 bit-equivalence claim.

b.native_global_policy: Unchanged pinned native base remains additional policy. Copy all 23 source path regexes into each proposal as local exclusions; no source-path restriction is discarded. Independent regex scoping prevents flags leaking between source alternatives. Native base also excludes office/PDF/binary paths and .git.
b.source_filter_arithmetic: Kingfisher counts UTF-8 bytes and accumulates f64 histogram Shannon entropy; every captured secret here is ASCII. Native byte-shannon-f64-v1 retains reject lt and threshold. No arbitrary Unicode-string or cross-platform log2 bit-equivalence claim.

formats.overlap: Existing provider and JWT findings remain observable. GitLab versioned PAT, Slack 147 and escaped-quote Monday improve extraction of already detected credentials.
formats.partial_extraction: HCP, Packagist and Slack refresh preserve source fixed-width prefix extraction. Finite boundary supplements reject longer-body prefixes.
formats.scope: Standalone ASCII credential formats and delimiter supplements; inherited native global predicates remain additional policy.

betterleaks.native_global_policy: Unchanged pinned native base remains additional policy. Copy all 23 source path regexes into each selected rule as local exclusions; no source-path restriction is discarded. Independent regex scoping prevents flags leaking between source alternatives. Native base also excludes office/PDF/binary paths and .git.
betterleaks.source_filter_arithmetic: Native byte-shannon-f64-v1 retains each original strict lt or inclusive le rejection and threshold over an ascending byte histogram with f64 arithmetic. All selected captured secrets are ASCII. No cross-platform log2 bit-equivalence claim.

source_policy.veles: Original Veles rules have no Betterleaks global filters or path prefilter; none is invented. Existing native inherited suppressions remain unchanged for every rule.

issuer_evidence.limits: Issuer evidence establishes roles, not the pinned hexadecimal suffix ranges or checksum validity.
role_support: ACS is the HMAC credential secret; standalone detection does not assert standalone bearer authentication.
ACK is the credential key and can authenticate GET requests without generating a signature.

limitations: Offline format candidates only; no online validity, checksum, entropy or precision claim.
No Kingfisher/Veles output parity or weighted interval selection claim.
Existing native allowlists and explicit resource exhaustion remain effective.
packagist_roles.precision_policy: Case-sensitive exact prefixes/lowercase hex and nonconsuming ASCII word boundaries. Complete-token adjacency rejects identifier substrings and overlong prefix slices. This boundary restriction is explicit relative to unguarded source regexes.
packagist_roles.score_contract: Count retained ACS and ACK occurrences separately by exact token span. A retained pair yields two visible findings for distinct roles, with no wrapper or nested helper duplicate. Extra ACK coverage is not a second ACS recovery.

source_selection.ack: Pinned Veles ACK grammar and partial detection plus issuer-documented API-key-only GET authentication. Deliberate visible native credential role, broader than Kingfisher hidden support and Veles conditional partial-output selection.
source_selection.acs: Pinned Kingfisher visible ACS detection has a validation-only ACK dependency with no within; it does not gate detection. Broader than original Veles pair-only ACS output.

bitwarden_disposition: original tuple matcher permits reversed and non-whitespace gaps; direct property requires a forward whitespace gap
original weighted nonoverlap selection may choose another nearby string; native binds the named property's own value
generated Kingfisher accepts broader path forms; native follows original literal suffix and Go lowercase preimages
original Veles has no entropy predicate; <=0 floor is inherited from generated Kingfisher scanner
remaining_verified.runtime_predicate_contract: Single strict typed native predicate; bytes-v1 outer regex required. Malformed Mapbox candidates reject and continue; cancellation and resource budgets return incomplete outcomes.
remaining_verified.scope: Complete source-backed Mapbox sk. and Vercel vck_ token formats with typed predicates; direct Bitwarden named-property admission on the original literal suffix.
remaining_verified.source_global_filtering: Existing native global policy is unchanged. Exact parsed Betterleaks filter and prefilter fields are retained as distinct secret/path rule allowlists.

residual.native_global_policy: Unchanged pinned native base remains additional policy. Copy all 23 source path regexes into each proposal as local exclusions; no source-path restriction is discarded. Independent regex scoping prevents flags leaking between source alternatives. Native base also excludes office/PDF/binary paths and .git.
residual.native_path_layer_note: Core path allowlists match the complete supplied fragment path. The pinned (?:^|/)\.git$ exclusion matches a path ending in .git, not repo/.git/config. DirectorySource with path_config can separately prune a .git directory before emitting descendant file fragments.
residual.source_filter_arithmetic: Kingfisher counts UTF-8 bytes and accumulates f64 histogram Shannon entropy; every captured secret here is ASCII. Native byte-shannon-f64-v1 retains reject lt and threshold. No arbitrary Unicode-string or cross-platform log2 bit-equivalence claim.

special.scope: Selected comma-boundary keys and MongoDB password, service URI medium-confidence domain, unsigned bearer JWT, long-context Kubernetes data and Cloudflare credential labels.
special.source_confidence: Service URI low-confidence categories are local exclusions selecting the source medium-confidence domain. No global confidence mode is added.

source_policy.detector_domain: Explicit ASCII folding, ASCII whitespace, and ASCII bounded gaps; non-ASCII context is excluded where it would widen a source byte bound into a native rune bound.
source_policy.native_global_policy: Keep the current inherited pinned global filter unchanged. No allowlist-sharing mode, exception, or broadening is selected.
source_policy.source_path_domain: Rule-local source path predicates are copied verbatim in independently scoped regexes. Source slash-only and case-sensitive branches are not silently normalized; native global policy is an additional layer.

special.tuple_binding: The two parent/helper pairs require native buffer-v1 same-candidate identity in the same raw or decoded input. Hidden helpers preserve whole-tuple predicates and never become reporting credentials.
special.yaml_boundaries: Reject both YAML document start and end markers; non-marker prefixes remain eligible.

rules.generated_overlay:
# Suppress only complete HTTPS credential URLs matched by the selected Veles adapters.
    # Host suffixes alone also hide unrelated hosts, ports, schemes, and empty usernames.
    filter_override: 'matchesAny(attributes["path"], [`(?i)(?:\.git[/\\]config|(?:^|[/\\])\.git-credentials|_history)$`]) && matchesAny(finding["captures"]["uri"], [`^https://[^:\s]+:[^\s@]+@(?:bitbucket\.org/[^\s]+\.git\b|git\.[^/]*codecatalyst\.aws/[^\s]*|git-codecommit\.[a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.amazonaws\.com/[^\s]+)$`])'
    validation: CredentialUri
    # Database endpoints commonly use private-CA or self-signed certificates. Honored only when
    # the operator also passes `--tls-mode lax`. HTTPS Basic Auth is validated separately;
    # plaintext HTTP and unsupported schemes are not live-validated.
    tls_mode: lax
transformations: Restrict schemes to postgres, postgresql, mysql and mariadb; retain the source username 0..128 and password 1..256 byte bounds, host-label and port bounds, unbounded host-list/IPv6/path repetitions, and consumed terminal alternatives.

Use the generated Kingfisher detector ASCII dialect: expand detection case folding and consumed classes explicitly, including whitespace bytes 09 through 0d and 20; keep the ASCII word boundary and raw password as sole capture 1. Betterleaks Go detection whitespace differs on vertical tab.

Map every global and URI rejection predicate to finite OR secret/match allowlists; wrap each independent regex in a noncapturing group before legacy alternation joining to contain its flags and preserve its internal precedence; preserve case-insensitive containsAny with secret stopwords.

Translate rejection-predicate shorthands with the generated runtime Go semantics: whitespace bytes 09, 0a, 0c, 0d and 20 exclude vertical tab; word and digit classes are ASCII. Detector whitespace and predicate whitespace are deliberately distinct.

Discard only the four known confidence-only bindings and setConfidence calculation; do not suppress low-confidence hosts, example passwords, test/documentation paths or synthetic tuples solely for that reason.
The generated path-and-secondary-capture overlay requires a lowercase https:// URI and is unreachable for these four database schemes; no relevant rejection is omitted.
Use native source policy, overlap behavior and resource controls; omit source prefilter, confidence, specificity and live validation. No URI parsing or percent decoding is performed.

transformations: Namespace rule IDs and descriptions; preserve source order and capture 1.
Remove reviewed extended-mode formatting; expand ASCII-insensitive literals and positive classes explicitly; preserve the case-sensitive JDBC password key.
Intersect negated byte classes with ASCII using explicit positive byte ranges; preserve all bounds, greediness, alternatives, and consumed delimiters.
Unroll the capture-free JDBC preceding-option repetition into sixteen sequential greedy optional groups; preserve 0 through 16 options without exceeding the existing nested-repeat product limit.
Map the complete case-insensitive secret substring exclusions to rule-local secret stopwords; preserve absent keywords as an empty list and omit the zero entropy floor.

Add a zero-width ASCII word boundary as the last host-key start alternative in the four semicolon forms, so a semicolon consumed by one match does not hide the next connection.
